objective: Equal seven-case geometric mean of median worker time. Retain incumbent unless challenger is >=3% faster in aggregate and improves geometric mean in every round against that incumbent. After per-backend selection, choose global winner under same3%+round consistency rule, retaining QBE on inconclusive cross-backend result.
heldoutPolicy: Freeze winners first; evaluate final eleven new heldouts once, accept only semantic success and <=1.03 aggregate reference ratio. Report individual regressions. No reranking on heldout.
